integrity: Analytical proof uses an independently reconstructed Markov interval partition and Perron–Frobenius projections; finite rational computations corroborate rather than certify the infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Results apply to Lebesgue measure for the fixed hole [3/4,5/6] of the doubling map. The defective golden-mean eigenvalue and transition graph are known, while the evaluated survival amplitudes and conditioned switch-time law are assessed as new at best knowledge; priority is not independently certified.
title: A polynomial escape prefactor and uniform macroscopic phase-switching law for the golden-mean double-pole hole
